title: Foundations of Faith
description: A comprehensive beginner roadmap covering core Islamic beliefs, pillars of worship, and the fundamentals of Salafi dawah.

courses.note: Start with understanding the methodology of the Salaf
Learn the foundational concept of Tawheed (monotheism)
Deepen your understanding of Islamic creed with Tim Humble
Master the rulings and proper performance of Salah
Complete your worship knowledge with Hajj and Umrah
